peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 4.1% above its local comparables; 69 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $775,000 ($1,726 psf, 430–462 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,658 psf (range $1,536–2,852); 4.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $31,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Terrace MRT about 250 m, Marine Parade MRT about 600 m; closer than 417 of 462 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ (Katong) Primary about 370 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Marine Terrace about 430 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 550 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (K Suites, 6 new sales, about 750 m; Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 880 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 940 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,060 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,360 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,600 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,640 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,770 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 376 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 89 new sales and 880 resales (969 purchases); new sales were 9.2% of these purchases. Subsales (17) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 880 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 384 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 880 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 954 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.8%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
